profile.name: Kendra Villalobos
profile.subline: Nursing roles for an ICU nurse with two years at the bedside · Tailored to your resume · Board assumes Salt Lake City
profile.recentRole: Intermountain Medical Center — Staff Nurse, Medical ICU (2024–2026)
profile.stack: ICU care, Epic charting, charge coverage, ACLS, rapid response, patient education
profile.target: Staff or charge nurse · Salt Lake City · acute care or clinical informatics
profile.summary: This board hires data, software and fintech people, and your resume is a clinical one, so the useful half of this page is the suggested hospitals and health systems below. The board's health-tech employers are a stretch unless you want to move into clinical informatics.
profile.applyNow: Start with the suggested health systems; every one of them hires ICU nurses year-round. On this board, only Recursion and Health Catalyst are even adjacent to your field.
profile.watchLater: If clinical informatics appeals, an Epic analyst certification would open the health-tech cards here.

suggested.name: Intermountain Health
suggested.why: Utah's largest health system, with ICU and step-down units across the valley and a nurse residency for anyone changing specialty.
suggested.note: Search 'ICU RN' and 'Registered Nurse' on their careers site; openings post weekly.

suggested.name: University of Utah Health
suggested.why: Academic medical center with multiple ICUs, a nurse residency and a clinical informatics group that hires RNs.
suggested.note: Look for 'Staff Nurse' and 'Nurse Informaticist' postings.

suggested.name: HCA Healthcare MountainStar
suggested.why: Six Wasatch Front hospitals with ICU openings most weeks.
suggested.note: Search 'RN ICU' on HCA's careers site and filter to Utah.

suggested.name: Steward Health Care Utah
suggested.why: Community hospitals in the valley that hire experienced critical-care nurses.
suggested.note: Check each hospital's own careers page.

suggested.name: VA Salt Lake City Health Care
suggested.why: Federal hospital with ICU seats and strong benefits; applications go through USAJOBS.
suggested.note: Search 'Nurse ICU Salt Lake City' on USAJOBS.

suggested.name: Epic Systems
suggested.why: The charting system you use every shift; Epic hires clinicians into implementation and analyst roles.
suggested.note: Search 'Clinical Informatics' and 'Implementation' on Epic's careers site.
